description: App-command grants for `chat-*` windows: 1:1 friend chat, with start and hang-up of a call to this peer and the peer's safety number with its mark-verified flow (the header's badge), and the group mode (plan E2.6): the group list, a group's stored messages, its send and typing, Leave, and the creator's Rename (decision 1a's `RoomName`), and opening a link preview's page (`open_external_url`, which asks in Rust before it opens). A friend's game invite: its game name and joining it (`launch_game`, the Host's `GameLaunch`), and inviting the friend to one of our favourite servers (`get_favourite_servers`, `send_game_invite`). The network status snapshot (`get_network_status`, read-only) so the composer shows "Publishing your identity…" while our own records are pending (plan FC3). No plugin grants.
